name: Passions
description:
Passions is an American television soap opera which aired on NBC from July 5, 1999 to September 7, 2007 and on The 101 Network from September 17, 2007 to August 7, 2008.

Passions follows the lives and loves, and various romantic and paranormal adventures of the residents of Harmony. Story-lines center around the interactions among members of its multi-racial core families — the African American Russells, white Cranes and Bennetts, and half-Mexican half-Irish Lopez-Fitzgeralds — as well as the supernatural including town witch Tabitha Lenox.

Created by writer James E. Reilly and produced by NBC Studios, the series was subsequently picked up by direct broadcast satellite service DirecTV, which broadcast new episodes airing on its exclusive channel The 101. In December 2007, DirecTV decided not to renew its contract for the series, and the studio was unable to sell the show elsewhere. The final episode aired on DirecTV on August 7, 2008.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Luis finds a member of the powerful Crane family on the beach; Sam Bennett prepares for his first day as the chief of police; Whitney Russell dreams of becoming a professional tennis player; a little girl warns Grace of danger.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Luis tries to arrest Ethan and Gwen for setting a fire on the beach; Gwen promises to visit Ethan's aunt in Paris; Theresa tells Whitney that she will marry Ethan; Grace faints after seeing the little girl; Tabitha warns Eve to beware the little girl.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Ethan gives in to Gwen's urging that he meet the townspeople; Theresa accidentally spills paint on Ethan; Luis tells Theresa he got her a summer job at Burger Hut; Kay fears Jessica will tell Miguel about her crush; Sheridan has a close call in Paris.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The little girl warns Grace that evil is all around them; Tabitha talks to the doll she is sewing; Theresa fantasizes about Ethan; Ethan calls Gwen for an update on Sheridan; Sheridan dreams of Princess Diana; Sheridan's boyfriend makes another date.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Luis encourages Pilar to remove her husband's name from the deed to the house; Ivy denies that she was unduly interested in Julian's conversation with Sam Bennett; Theresa confides her dreams of Ethan to her mother; Sheridan awakens in the hospital.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Theresa reluctantly takes the job at Burger Hut; Ethan shows up at Burger Hut and recognizes Theresa; Sheridan and Gwen have a heart-to-heart chat; Tabitha offers the Bennetts a gift; a woman who looks like Grace has a nightmare about running in a forest.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Ethan believes Theresa is a stalker; Theresa gets fired and, as she leaves, causes a fire; Sheridan urges Ethan to propose to Gwen; Mimi confronts Jean Luc about Sheridan; Tabitha dresses up as a fortune teller for the carnival; Sam seeks information.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Faith's daughter, Charity, asks why they are always on the move; Charity learns that Faith has a sister named Grace; Theresa and Whitney are horrified by Tabitha's predictions; Sheridan accepts Jean Luc's proposal; Mimi is furious.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: T.C. confronts Tabitha as Timmy hides in the shadows; T.C. is shaken by Tabitha's response; Eve visits the fortune teller; Mimi is determined to tell Sheridan the truth about Jean Luc; Miguel sees Theresa crying; Luis has another job for Theresa

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Jean Luc tries to end his association with Roger; Gwen is upset by the message in her fortune cookie; Eve runs from Tabitha's tent; Tabitha tells Theresa she will one day be Mrs. Ethan Crane; Charity and Faith arrive at the carnival; Charity meets Miguel.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Jean Luc's partners are not happy and plan to make him pay; Sheridan heads to Jean Luc's apartment; Tabitha and Timmy find themselves spinning in thin air; Grace goes in search of the gypsy; Theresa watches as Ethan proposes to Gwen.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Sam and Grace get closer to Faith as they approach the gypsy's tent; the gypsy tent suddenly disappears; Charity runs into Miguel again; Gwen refuses Ethan's proposal, but Ethan is sure she is teasing him; Theresa takes the job at the Cannery.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Theresa mourns the loss of her dreams on her first shift at the Cannery; Pilar stops back at the Crane mansion to finish some work; Luis resents the care his mother gives the Crane family; Julian's affair with Suzanne heats up; Ivy gets a revolver.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Kay and Simone fix the Mr. Harmony contest; Jessica plots to have Kay wind up with the school nerd rather than Miguel; Theresa learns that Gwen and Ethan are not engaged; Ivy sends Pilar home; Jean Luc chases after Sheridan; Mimi insists on going too.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Tabitha tells Timmy that Charity's innate powers may foil their plans; Charity presses Faith for answers; Theresa quits the Cannery before being fired; Ethan and Luis butt heads; Julian calls the mayor; Whitney worries when Theresa confides in her.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Kay ignores Jessica's teasing, certain she can woo Miguel; Theresa avoids Luis to delay seeing his reaction to her job loss; Ethan searches for the identity of his stalker; Charity finds her mother on the floor; Tabitha realizes Grace is Faith's twin.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Heartbroken, Sheridan tears up photos of Jean Luc; Roger does not believe Sheridan is dead; Jessica's plan to embarrass Kay goes smoothly; Ivy and Pilar discuss family; Sam tries to ease Grace's fears by informing her of his Internet search.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Kay congratulates Miguel on winning the contest; Kay sets up a mystery date for Miguel; Ivy is concerned about Ethan's stalker; Theresa sneaks out to apologize to the Cranes; Ivy takes a liking to Theresa; Charity and Faith miss their bus.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Pierre and Roger comb the air port looking for Sheridan; Ethan and Gwen put off meeting Theresa as Ivy gives her a tour of the mansion; Kay's parents are aghast at her seductive outfit; Tabitha takes control of Charity as she sleeps.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Sheridan gives Ethan the details of her breakup with Jean Luc; Ethan vows to make an example of the girl who is stalking him; Tabitha loses her grip on Charity when Grace calls; Faith knows evil is chasing them; Reese pursues Kay, who is chasing Miguel.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Theresa is trapped in the lap of luxury; Ethan continues his crusade against those who target the rich; Tabitha's spirit board spells trouble for Faith and Grace; Kay figures out that her date is actually with Reese; Miguel hopes Charity will show up.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Tabitha drives Faith away from Grace with a storm; Kay schemes to salvage her evening; Theresa flees from the Crane mansion before Ethan can discover her; Ethan's fury at Jean Luc's betrayal makes him overprotective of Sheridan; Sheridan meets Luis.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Ivy and Ethan discuss relationships; Sam back Luis up on his arrest of Sheridan; Ethan is angry that he cannot immediately free his aunt from jail; Theresa decides to turn down the job; Charity follows the sounds of a lost child; Tabitha may win.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Charity helps search for Tabitha's granddaughter; Faith and Grace seek help from the same priest; Sheridan learns that Gwen rejected Ethan's proposal; Julian threatens to fire Pilar for her son's behavior; Theresa finds herself running from the Cranes.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Faith and Grace cross paths again in the church; Miguel rescues Charity; Tabitha and Timmy's plans are thwarted; Gwen wishes she had not turned down Ethan's proposal; Luis answers an alarm at the Crane mansion; Sheridan is intrigued.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Kay plans a trip to the pier where Miguel will be working; he tells her he has found Charity, who cannot find the will to make her powers surface; Theresa wants to change her look; Ethan and Ivy determine to send the stalker to jail.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Charity travels to Harmony on her own to find Miguel; Kay hopes to keep Charity and Miguel apart; Theresa updates her look to keep her job at the mansion; Sheridan dreams of a handsome stranger; Sam is suspicious of Luis and Sheridan.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Sheridan has another run-in with Luis; Luis asks Sheridan about the man who broke her heart; Frank inquires about Ethan's stalker; Theresa's masquerade may soon be over; Jessica foils Kay's plans to keep Charity and Miguel apart; a search party is out.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Theresa narrowly escapes being recognized as Ethan's stalker; Pilar is nervous about Theresa's masquerade; Kay and Simone can't separate Charity and Miguel; Grace invites Tabitha to lunch; Sheridan is haunted by her childhood memories.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: T.C. and Eve are concerned about Whitney's future; Sheridan plans another move; Ethan wants to keep Sheridan in town; Pilar's birthday party may mean trouble for Theresa; Kay is jealous; Grace's tardiness proves fateful when her sister calls.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Charity misses her bus and is forced to take a cab home; Tabitha turns out to be Charity's cab driver; Faith and Grace make a telephone connection; Pilar's party continues; Ethan and Theresa play cat and mouse; Luis plays with fire.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Miguel comes to Charity's rescue; Tabitha's plan for Charity is thwarted by Miguel's arrival; Faith tells Charity that they must move away; Julian and Sam meet about the police department budget; T.C.'s knees continue to bother him.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Luis and Sheridan find common ground at the beach; Julian does not want to use sexual harassment as Sheridan's defense; Theresa enjoys her time at the country club until she runs into Frank; Whitney is offered a corporate sponsorship.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Whitney decides to stop working at the club; Theresa insists that both she and Whitney belong at the club; Sheridan is assigned community service at the youth center; Charity makes a last-minute visit to Harmony; Tabitha and Timmy celebrate.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Charity's return to Harmony cuts short Tabitha and Timmy's celebration; Charity comes close to finding Grace and reuniting with Miguel; Sheridan is confused; Hank is back in Harmony; Luis and Sheridan continue to clash.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Charity and Miguel search for Charity's aunt; Kay pays Jessica back for her schemes; Jessica continues to help Charity and Miguel; Grace comes close to remembering her past; Sam reunites with Hank; Luis and Beth recall their past romance.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: The Internet connection between Faith and Grace sheds light on Grace's past; Timmy thinks he is doomed; Luis learns of Sheridan's assignment to the youth center; Sheridan takes her check back; Theresa and Whitney convince Ethan to end his search.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Faith tries to convince Grace of the evil stalking their family; Tabitha works to keep Grace in the dark; Charity is ready to give up; Luis and Sheridan realize they are stuck with each other; Frank is determined to expose Whitney and Theresa.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Tabitha keeps Grace from discovering Faith and Charity; Kay realizes that Charity may be Grace's link to her past; Charity is able to override Faith's hysteria; Theresa thinks she is in the clear; Gwen tries to get Ethan's mind off his stalker.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Whitney and Theresa do not realize their luck; Ethan tells Gwen he will ask her to marry him when the time is right; Theresa fantasizes about Ethan; Grace tells Eve what she has learned about her past; Faith demands that Charity leave Harmony.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Sheridan is haunted by the memories of her past; Pilar tries to comfort Sheridan; Hank asks Luis about his father and brother; Sam and Grace realize that Charity is probably Grace's niece; Simone wants Kay to tell her parents where Charity is.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Ethan worries about Sheridan's date with Hank; Luis prepares for his date with Beth; Pilar begs Luis to go easy on Sheridan; Sam and Grace watch as Charity rides away with Miguel; Faith's candle goes out and howling can be heard from outside.
